# fastly_ai_runtime_control (Resource)

Enables AI Runtime Control for the account. Destroying this resource disables the product.



## Schema

### Optional

- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether AI Runtime Control is enabled for the account. Defaults to `true`.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource (always `ai_runtime_control`).
